newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Two Russian servicemen desert with machine-gun.
newsitem.headline: Two Russian servicemen desert with machine-gun.

text.p: Two Interior Ministry soldiers were on the run in southern Russia on Sunday armed with a machine-gun, an automatic rifle and ammunition, police said.
A spokesman for police in the Stavropol region of southern Russia, near the border with rebel Chechnya, said the two men had deserted on Saturday.
"The two men, both of them interior ministry troops, escaped on Saturday with a machine-gun, an automatic weapon and a supply of ammunition," the spokesman said by telephone.

He said police and Interior Ministry troops were blocking all routes out of the region. But he said they might have gone to Chechnya, where Russian troops fought a 21-month war with separatists, or could be hiding in a remote village.
Desertions from the army and Interior Ministry units are common but servicemen are rarely reported to have made off with such powerful weapons.
